name: miadi-session-observability
description: Session capture for Miadi hosts, installed once per host instead of hand-wired into settings.json. Every Claude Code event is written under <root>/<session_id>/ exactly as /opt/binscripts/hooks/claude_hooks writes it, so the token counter, the /token-usage page and the session observers keep working. Every session start, end and rename also writes a binding line: the session id, the tmux pane it runs in (session:window.pane), its command line, its name history and its team. The session-continuity skill carries the T1 practice: binding, tmux save and restore, tide bringing agents back, and rebuilding what each pane held after a crash.
